messages:
Priya (PM): quick thread to align on the Hosted API slate for the next quarter — focusing on 4 bets: streaming reliability, embeddings unit-cost, rerank SLA, and safer canaries. want to sync tradeoffs and launch criteria today.
Marco (Eng): ok. do we have clear capacity targets if streaming increases qps?
Priya (PM): good q — goal is to support +2x concurrent streaming sessions for peak while keeping p95 gen latency < 300ms for hosted tier.
Leah (Product): customers pushing on embeddings cost and rerank latency — AcmeHealth and Origami both asked for <150ms rerank p95 on short docs. that feels tight.
Jin (SRE): rerank p95 <150ms is doable but needs faster kernels or smaller model variant + caching. needs infra commit: 8 extra GPUs for canary window or smarter batching.
Marco (Eng): proposal: ship a two-variant model plan. default is quantized 8-bit with cache; premium is fp16 for higher throughput. route by customer tier.
Priya (PM): that's the routing plan we discussed. can we define concrete ship criteria (pass/fail) so sales and customers have clarity?
Leah (Product): suggested launch criteria:
- Stability: <0.5% errors over 7d canary
- Latency: rerank p95 <= 160ms in prod with 95% traffic weighted sampling
- Cost: embeddings unit cost <= $0.45 per 1k tokens with caching enabled
- Quality: no regen-quality regression >2% against baseline prompt set

Marco (Eng): rough engineering checklist:
- streaming: implement request-level backpressure + connection-level autoscale
- KV-cache: improve eviction heuristics and expose TTL per model
- routing: policy layer to pin by customer tier/model variant

Jin (SRE): monitoring & rollout needs:
```
canary:
  traffic: 10%
  duration: 72h
  alerting:
    - p95_latency > 200ms
    - error_rate > 0.5%
```
If any alert fires twice -> rollback.

Priya (PM): +1 on that policy. add a quality gate: evaluation harness run daily, and failure of eval set -> stop rollout and notify SRE.
Leah (Product): who owns customer comms for Origami/AcmeHealth in the canary? want a heads-up email and an SLA playbook.
Priya (PM): Leah will draft comms, Marco will provide timing, Jin to confirm monitoring hooks.
Marco (Eng): timeline ask: engineering needs 3 sprints to implement streaming/backpressure + cache changes, then 1 sprint for canary instrumentation. realistic?
Jin (SRE): sounds right if infra allocation approved. we should reserve capacity early to avoid noisy neighbor issues during canary.
Leah (Product): runbook for post-launch ops: include cost dashboard, per-customer latency heatmap, and auto-fallback to fp16 variant if p95 breach.
Priya (PM): ok action items:
- Leah: draft customer comms + runbook (due in 5 working days)
- Marco: design doc for two-variant routing + backpressure (due EOD next Tue)
- Jin: canary alert dashboard + capacity req (due in 4 working days)

Marco (Eng): tagging infra leads and infra-cost owners in doc. small Q: do we target Dedicated customers for initial ramp or do hosted-first?
Priya (PM): hosted-first for safety and faster feedback, but Dedicated will be prioritized for customers on contracts. treat Dedicated as separate rollout with same criteria.
Leah (Product): ok. i'll add pricing notes: temporary discount for early adopters to offset perf risk.
Jin (SRE): deploy-bot: starting canary infra reservation now. :eyes:
deploy-bot: Reserved 8 GPUs in us-west-2 for canary window (resv-2024q4-17255).
Priya (PM): thanks all. i'll synthesize into a short PRD and link here when done. :thumbsup:
Marco (Eng): will comment on design doc draft once posted.
Leah (Product): adding customer contacts to the PRD.
Jin (SRE): will add SLO adjustments and update on-call playbook.
Priya (PM): end of thread — quick sync tomorrow 09:30 PT to confirm scoping.
